language.title: Language
language.settingHelp: Your language is saved to your account and used on every device you sign in on. Readings always use Western digits and a decimal point, like the equipment panels.
language.savedOnDeviceOnly: The language changed on this device, but it could not be saved to your account. Other devices keep the previous language.

interlock.withPartner: Interlocked with {{partner}}: turning this on switches the partner off

desc.protocol: Written by the farm's human agronomist (the agronomist protocol). Read-only in SenseHub; it stays authoritative.
desc.operator: Entered or edited by the farm team in SenseHub: targets, crop profile, tank recipes, notes.
desc.measured: Read from sensors and meters: flow meter and tank litres, feed EC / pH, climate.
desc.calculated: Worked out by SenseHub from other values with fixed rules and assumptions (e.g. the 1:150 design dilution, min / max bands, EC scaling, EC estimates). Not measured.
desc.ai: Written by the AI fertilizer advisor or AI agronomist. A second opinion only: check it against the protocol and your data before acting.

basis.label: Based on
basis.aiOnly: AI knowledge – not from your data
basis.aiOnlyHint: The AI used only its own general agronomy knowledge here, not the farm's protocol, targets, notes or measurements. Check it with the agronomist before acting.

legend.title: What the markings mean
legend.basisNote: Every AI item says what it is based on. A dashed “AI knowledge – not from your data” item rests only on the AI's general knowledge.
legend.derivedNote: Two icons = derived: e.g. calculator + document = calculated by SenseHub from the protocol.
